desktop.title: Notifications & access
desktop.notificationsHint: Get notified about approvals, reminders and task failures.
desktop.testDelivered: The notification reached Notification Center. Banners still depend on Focus mode and notification style.
desktop.testSent: The system accepted the notification; display is not confirmed. Check Notification Center or system settings.
desktop.externalUrlHint: Optional. Enter the http/https address used externally without a port; leave blank to use discovered LAN addresses.
desktop.portHint: Nerya listens on this port locally by default. Enabling other-device access exposes the same port to the LAN. Range: 1024–65535.
desktop.sharingHint: Requires the login password. When off, the port is local-only and can be used by a local Tunnel; when on, other devices can use the same port.
desktop.passwordHint: Set a login password above before enabling access.
desktop.confirmMessage: Your workspace will be reachable over the network and require the login password. Use a trusted LAN; use HTTPS or a VPN for public access.
desktop.security: HTTP is not encrypted. Use a trusted LAN, or HTTPS / a VPN for public access.
desktop.quiet: Permission is granted, but system banners are disabled.

errors.generic: The operation did not complete. Please retry.
errors.admin_password_required_before_sharing: Set a login password above first.
errors.sharing_port_unavailable: That port is unavailable or already in use. Choose another port.
errors.invalid_external_url: External access URL must be a valid http/https origin without a path, credentials, query or fragment.
errors.external_url_must_not_include_port: Do not put the port in the URL; use the port field below.
errors.notification_permission_denied: The system has not allowed Nerya to send notifications.
errors.notification_permission_failed: Could not read notification permission. Check system settings.
errors.notification_delivery_failed: The system rejected the notification; it was not sent.
errors.notification_settings_unavailable: Open notification settings manually in system settings.
errors.desktop_preferences_not_saved: Settings were not saved. Previous settings remain active.
errors.desktop_command_timeout: The app service did not respond. Please retry.
